Heavy 1: runner foundations

Five-week rotation: 1/5. Tuesday main resistance session.

Heavy means the main resistance session, not maximal lifting: use bodyweight first, then your two dumbbells (up to 5 kg each) or a kettlebell you can control comfortably. Finish each set with 2-3 reps in reserve, never to failure. If new to these exercises, use one set for the first two weeks; otherwise use the sets listed. Train after the easy run or separate by several hours. Light sessions are bodyweight only, easy effort, and should not cause soreness. Stop for sharp pain, dizziness or unusual symptoms; get technique help if unsure.

Warm-up: 5 min easy walking or marching, then 8 bodyweight squats and 8 unloaded hip hinges.

Single-leg calf raises: 2 sets x 12 reps per side. Hold a support; rise smoothly and lower for 3 seconds. Rest 30 s between sides and 60 s between sets.

Supported split squats: 2 sets x 8 reps per side. Bodyweight first, adding light dumbbells only with steady form. Rest 30 s between sides and 75 s between sets. Alternative: 2 x 8 step-ups per side onto a low, stable step; do not do both.

Glute bridges: 2 sets x 12 reps, pause 2 seconds at the top. Bodyweight or one securely held light weight. Rest 60 s between sets.

Romanian deadlifts: 2 sets x 10 reps with two light dumbbells or one comfortable kettlebell. Hinge at the hips, soften knees, lower for 3 seconds. Rest 90 s between sets.

Rest 60-90 s when changing exercises. Finish with 2-3 min easy walking. Allow about 30-40 min; reduce to one set if it compromises Thursday running.

Warm-up: 1.5 mi easy at 9:00-9:45/mi. Main set: 2 x 5 min at threshold, 7:10-7:25/mi, with 2.5 min easy jog between repetitions (0.266667 mi total at 9:22.5/mi reference); then 0.247096 mi easy to complete the allocated mileage. Cool-down: 1 mi easy at 9:00-9:45/mi. Main-set quality miles: 1.3714. Quality distance is estimated at the threshold midpoint. Keep the work controlled, not maximal; Thursday is the other quality day. If recovery is poor, run easy instead. Do the Tuesday strength session after running, not before; skip or reduce it if fatigued.
Wednesday evening: about 90 minutes, light and easy intensity only, no hard matches because Thursday is a quality day.
Easy conversational run, HR under 146. Light badminton in the evening, about 90 minutes, no hard matches.
